_README: Injury returns -- the INVERSE of known_absences.json. Superstars who missed most or
all of LAST season but are expected (near-)available this season. Such a player is
otherwise mis-projected three ways: (1) his minutes fall back to a bench default
because he supplied almost none last year (Haliburton -> 8.0 mpg), (2) the availability
model drags him down on his games-missed history, and (3) a partial injured-season
sample can distort his talent split (Tatum's 16 games in 2025-26 inflated his defense).
Each entry re-projects the player AS his last healthy season (basis_season): his
injured/partial seasons after basis are dropped from the projection inputs, so the
normal aging + shrinkage machinery restores his pre-injury offense/defense (box AND
RAPM) instead of us hand-entering numbers; his role (minutes per game) is taken from
the basis season; and his availability is set to the expected value here.
This file is MANUAL and forward-looking, exactly like known_absences.json -- there is
no reliable free feed for 'expected back and how eased-in'. It is applied to the LIVE
upcoming-season bundle ONLY, never to the walk-forward backtest (which uses real
historical rosters and cannot see the future). The numbers below are USER JUDGMENT and
are meant to be edited. Anything not listed here is handled statistically as usual.
Fields:
basis_season          season_start of the last healthy season to project from
(e.g. 2024 = 2024-25). null = auto-detect the most recent
season with >= 1500 minutes.
expected_availability share of the 82 games we expect the player available, 0-1.
RAISES the model estimate (an absence floor would lower it).
minute_restriction    multiplier on the basis season's minutes-per-game for an
eased-in return (1.0 = full role; 0.95 = light early limit).
player_id             must match nba_api PERSON_ID.

returns.reason: Ruptured right Achilles (May 2025, 2024-25 playoffs). User expects ~100% by opening night. Basis 2024-25: 72 G, 36.4 mpg, +3.5 impact. Drops the distorted 16-game 2025-26 return sample.

Ruptured right Achilles (June 2025, 2024-25 Finals); missed all of 2025-26. User expects him back near opening night but eased in through ~the first quarter (minute limits, some back-to-back rest). Basis 2024-25: 73 G, 33.6 mpg, +1.9 impact.

Torn right ACL (Sept 2025 camp); missed all of 2025-26. Back near opening night at ~13 months out. NOTE: our metric rated his last healthy season (2024-25) at -1.1 impact (below replacement), so restoring 'pre-injury level' restores a slightly negative rating -- the real effect here is fixing his minutes (bench fallback -> ~33 mpg). Basis 2024-25: 60 G, 35.2 mpg, -1.1 impact.

Torn left ACL (March 2025); missed all of 2025-26. ~19 months out by opening night, so physically back, but 34 and Dallas likely cautious -- eased-in estimate. Basis 2024-25: 50 G (pre-injury), 36.0 mpg, +1.3 impact.

Ruptured Achilles (April 2025 playoffs); missed all of 2025-26. Biggest question mark of this list: 36 years old and Achilles ruptures at that age are the least likely to return to prior level -- 'pre-injury contribution' is optimistic here, so availability + minutes are set conservatively. Basis 2024-25: 58 G (pre-injury), 36.1 mpg, +2.2 impact.
